name: Mstsc.EXE Execution From Uncommon Parent
description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.parent.executable:(*\\brave.exe OR *\\CCleanerBrowser.exe OR *\\chrome.exe OR *\\chromium.exe OR *\\firefox.exe OR *\\iexplore.exe OR *\\microsoftedge.exe OR *\\msedge.exe OR *\\opera.exe OR *\\vivaldi.exe OR *\\whale.exe OR *\\outlook.exe)) AND (process.executable:*\\mstsc.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:mstsc.exe)
